rule.comparison: full 2D masks in original frame coordinates
rule.single_remaining: select directly per user; flag crop/reference risks
rule.reference_masks: non-intersecting retained masks inform matching/containment; never selected; never bridge groups
rule.crop_contact_policy: warning only; other conflicts may defer

noise_filter.width_definition: min rotated rectangle of pixel centers plus one pixel

rule.consistent_triple_with_extras: select consistent original/local/SAM main; remaining non-noise fragments defer separately

semantic_route.mask_input: existing non-overlapping SAM partition; all nonempty labels before downstream gates
semantic_route.margin_definition: max cosine of all target terms minus max cosine of all control terms; not probability
semantic_route.sam_hit_policy: select each hit SAM partition unchanged; no post-recognition filtering
semantic_route.cropformer_hit_policy: withdraw directly overlapping CropFormer masks from all generic processing; keep only as comparison
semantic_route.cabinet_scope: cabinets, cupboards, wardrobes with cabinet bodies; excludes open bookshelves and storage racks
semantic_route.not_hit_policy: use unchanged ordinary selection rules after removing semantic SAM hits and corresponding CropFormer masks

cabinet_context.padding_each_side: max(80 native pixels, bbox width or height)
cabinet_context.scope: same original ROI RGB input; clipped at input boundary
